learning_outcomes.text: Students analyze business problems with regard to possible solutions through AI systems.
Students assess which AI techniques are most suitable for solving problems in companies.
Students create their own AI-based solutions for problems in companies and implement them prototypically using suitable software.
Students can develop their own AI systems and defend them against competing approaches.
Students can present their own results and discuss developed solutions with other students.

syllabus_topics: Processing of AI projects on current topics including discussion and presentation
